scenario.description: The Head of Learning must appoint an internal facilitator for a six-session difficult-conversations workshop series and finalize the evidence record, schedule, participation safeguards, and review process.

shared_context.S1: The company is organizing a six-session internal workshop series on handling difficult workplace conversations.
shared_context.S2: Mira and Theo are the two employees being considered as the primary facilitator.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding appointment and approves the workshop operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The standard planning routine is for Elena to hear from the candidates, a peer colleague, and the program coordinator before finalizing an internal learning assignment.

PF1.text: Marcus has directly observed Mira lead exactly five difficult-conversation practice sessions, including two where she successfully de-escalated an upset participant; he has not put these observations into a formal feedback record.

PF2.text: Theo has not completed the required de-escalation module and therefore is not currently eligible to serve as the primary facilitator; he assumed the completion status was already visible in the learning system and did not raise it with Elena.

PF3.text: Mira has an approved caregiving arrangement that requires any workshop session she facilitates to end by 16:00; she has not yet discussed the scheduling constraint with Elena because the session calendar is still being drafted.

PF4.text: Janelle confirmed this week that internal facilitators must have at least five observed practice sessions, obtain written participant opt-in for a difficult-conversations series, and receive a review after the third session; these requirements have not been added to the assignment packet.

acceptance_conditions: Mira must be appointed as the primary facilitator.
The assignment packet must record exactly five observed practice sessions.
Every facilitated session must end by 16:00.
Written participant opt-in must be required.
A review must be scheduled after the third session.
The settlement must include a commitment to obtain written participant opt-in.
The settlement must include a commitment to conduct the third-session review.

content_checks.C6: any('written participant opt-in' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('third session' in c['detail'] or 'third-session review' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's five firsthand observations provide the evidence for choosing Mira and change the assignment record's observed-practice count from unspecified to exactly 5.
Theo's incomplete de-escalation module changes the candidate decision by making Theo ineligible as primary facilitator and leaving Mira as the eligible choice.
Mira's approved caregiving arrangement changes the session plan from an ordinary unrestricted end time to an exact 16:00 end time.

Janelle's confirmed learning requirements change the packet by requiring written participant opt-in and fixing the review point after exactly the third session, along with commitments to carry out both steps.
